rendered.subject: Collaboration Proposal
rendered.body:
Hi Fly By Jing team,

We are a small team dedicated to crafting engaging Instagram content. We’d like to propose a collaborative Instagram post with you and Fly By Jing, built on the fact that partnering with other brands is a key tactic for their community-building strategy [P3]. The founder and CEO Jing Gao shared her experiences navigating the coronavirus pandemic, emphasizing the crucial role of pre-existing demand signals in building brand loyalty. Essentially, this post would showcase a shared visual experience, reflecting the brand’s unique approach to building connections. It would aim to visually represent the core values of Fly By Jing – a thoughtful and flavorful experience.

Please reply with your thoughts.

The BrandPilot team
